author: Bobby Grayson

metadata.prompt:
We desperately need to simplify the code in deciduous. The Elixir rewrite proves that we have a large amount of complexity and unused code that is generally able to be simplified or deleted.

To begin work on this, I want to start by making a branch called `cleanup` and begin by doing an analysis of the structure of the Elixir version of the application and its decision tree (@../decidulixir) and looking at our code here and then seeing where we could drastically simplify things by using the hindsight that fresh design allowed to simplify things.

Then, from that report, I want to make a strategy where we can open a series of issues to improve things overall and slowly get rolling.

title: Simplify deciduous codebase using lessons from Elixir rewrite
